ValidationRule.description: Restrict the user from changing the Status and Date Received of a closed case for Pin & Selfie Recovery Cases, TrustMe Cases & ReKYC Case
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR ( ISCHANGED( Status ) , ISCHANGED( IDR_Date_Received__c ) ), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName == 'PIN_Recovery', RecordType.DeveloperName == 'Selfie_Recovery', RecordType.DeveloperName == 'TrustMe_eIDV_QA_Case', RecordType.DeveloperName == 'TrustMe_eIDV_Case', RecordType.DeveloperName == 'ReKYC_QA_Case' ), IsClosed )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to modify a closed case.
